main_text.l: Christo;quorum verborum haec est Paraphrasis.
“ Arma Pastorum Evangelicorum sunt po-
testas ligandi & solvendi, potestas verbi, “
quae tota est spiritualis, & toto cælo differt “
& distat à potestate Regum, Principum & “
Magistratuum qui sedent ad clavum reipublicæ:
horum potestas ad externum
hominem pertinet, in corpora duntaxat agens,
“ adigens ad obsequium sui, etiam nolentes, “
invitos & repugnantes, & solas externas “
actiones regens. Illorum potestas ejusmo-
di est, ut in solos quidem volentes agat, “
sed quos ex nolentibus, invitis & repug-
nantibus, volentes præstet, sic afficiens illos “
in quos agit, ut omnia argumenta, consilia &
mandata suggesta à Satana, mundo & “
carne potlhabeant, rationibus Divinis
& “ necessitati parendi Deo, potestas est Dei, “
ad salutem, novam vitam, novam imagi-
nem, quæ sua natura & perse compedibus “
peccatorum & affectuum vinctos solvit; at “
per accidens rebelles & immorigeros arctius “
constringit: potestas est quæ animum prius “
vincit, & pervincit, movet & permovet, “
suadet & persuadet, quam corpus secum trahat:
denique potestas est quæ omnes affec-
tus internos, amorem mundi, vitæ retinacula, pretia & lenocinia
voluptatum aut jugulat, aut mancipat cruci Christi.

page.notes: Pencilled number "328" at upper right margin is handwriting and was not transcribed. Ink/print specks and a "Digitized by Google" watermark at lower right were omitted. The left-hand quotation marks are printed line-starts of the quoted passage, kept as “. Word "potlhabeant" reads as printed; "perse" as printed.
